concerns.text: Functional Requirement FR-010 (loss‑landscape logging with per‑epoch loss, ΔL, plateau detection) has no corresponding task in tasks.md. No task implements the required JSON‑lines logging or validates its schema.
The implementation plan references a quick‑start guide (quickstart.md) but there is no task that creates, updates, or validates this document.
The data‑model design document (data-model.md) is listed in the plan, yet tasks.md contains no task to implement, verify, or document the data model schema.
